title: Release scripts exit 0 having done nothing when invoked through a symlinked path (entry-point guard compares unresolved argv[1])
description:
Found 2026-09-28 while building QCLI-402's end-to-end test. The release scripts run main() only when `resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)`. resolve() does not follow symlinks, but import.meta.url is the resolved module path. So invoking a script through a symlinked path (macOS tmpdir /var -> /private/var, or a symlinked checkout) makes the comparison false, and the script exits 0 with no output, having done nothing. Measured: promote-release.mjs copied under mkdtemp(tmpdir()) and run with --promote exited 0 with empty stderr and made zero gh or npm calls. Run through its realpath, the same copy refused with exit 1 as expected.

For a release script, a silent exit 0 is the worst outcome: a promotion that never ran reads as a promotion that succeeded. It is not a live risk today, because the runbook invokes the scripts from the checkout's real path, but nothing enforces that.

Files with this guard (grep at dev, 10): scripts/build-candidate-bundle.mjs scripts/check-lockfile-pins.mjs scripts/github-release.mjs scripts/check-breaking-bump.mjs scripts/promote-release.mjs scripts/qualification/e2e-receipt.mjs scripts/qualification/version-parity.mjs scripts/publish-release.mjs scripts/qualification/bundle-integrity.mjs scripts/qualification/native-execution-receipt.mjs

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every script with the entry-point guard runs main() when invoked through a symlinked path to itself. The fix compares resolved real paths on both sides, or otherwise stops a symlinked invocation from exiting 0 having done nothing.

A test invokes at least promote-release.mjs through a symlink and shows it reaches main(): it refuses or proceeds as it would through the real path, and never exits 0 silently. The same test fails against the current guard.
The list of affected scripts is re-enumerated with grep when this is implemented, and the count is stated, rather than taken from the 10 in this description.
